question: Should OpenClaw adopt this taxonomy-wide strict coverage identity model, including the intentional reduction of `smoke-ci` categories to only the categories the fixed smoke plan proves?
rationale: This is an internal QA-policy and evidence-semantics choice with broad downstream reporting effects; source review can validate consistency but cannot choose the intended coverage-accounting standard without QA-owner intent.

options.title: Accept the strict ownership model
options.body: Approve the one-feature/one-two-part-ID model after rebasing and confirming the profile narrowing is the intended truthfulness correction.

options.title: Keep broader profile accounting
options.body: Request a narrower revision that preserves the existing profile/category interpretation while fixing only duplicate identifier ownership.

recommendation.title: Accept the strict ownership model
